prompt_stages.codex56_possibility_slate: Invent at least four materially different, original, warm Lost and Found Frequency audio-mystery possibilities from the immutable constraint ingress. The world is ordinary, contemporary or timeless, and human-scale: no speculative technology, ancient artifacts, laboratories, supernatural forces, secret experiments, crime plots, or science-fiction framing. The listed lost possessions remain separate mundane belongings; never combine or reinterpret them as components of a key, artifact, machine, or research specimen. On EVERY possibility, copy the ingress draw's lost_objects array and acoustic_device string VERBATIM into those exact typed fields; do not paraphrase them. Use that mundane device as the only shared cause and culminate in the supplied helpful_ending; do not substitute a storm, outage, crime, or different mechanism. Use string possibility IDs such as p1, p2, p3, p4. Make audible clues occur in fair order. No violence, weapons, blood, threats, cruelty, profanity, smoking, intoxicants, brands, public figures, franchises, adaptations, lyrics, or copied characters. Names must be fictional. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_slate_triage: Act as a technical contract checker. Select one possibility that is causally solvable through sound and complies with every safety and originality constraint. Findings must identify concrete fields; do not assign an originality score and do not rewrite prose. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_audible_truth_map: Build the selected possibility into a complete causal truth map. Preserve the ordinary-world Lost and Found Frequency identity: every lost possession remains a separate mundane belonging, the draw's acoustic_device is the only cause, and the supplied helpful ending remains the closure. Never reinterpret the possessions as artifact components, a key, speculative technology, research material, or supernatural evidence. The top level has exactly these fields: title, premise, setting, desk_operator_name, caller_threads, causal_steps, audible_clues, interpretations, reveal, resolution_links. causal_steps, audible_clues, interpretations, and resolution_links are TOP-LEVEL arrays only; never nest them inside caller_threads. Every caller_threads row has exactly thread_id, caller_name, lost_object, practical_need. Create exactly one caller_threads row for every selected lost_objects entry, put exactly one lost object in that row's singular lost_object field, give every caller thread at least one audible clue, and create exactly one resolution_links row for every caller thread. Emit only schema-declared fields; never create numbered or suffixed fields such as lost_object_2, lost_object_secondary, or resolution_links_2. Include at least two interpretations: at least one true and at least one plausible false interpretation. Every interpretation must cite at least one existing audible clue ID; clue_ids must never be empty. The listener must be able to solve it before the reveal. Keep the announcer brief and never let the announcer solve the puzzle. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_fair_play_audit: Audit the supplied truth map against grounding_contract for exact causal closure, clue-before-reveal order, audible sufficiency, separate mundane lost possessions, the declared acoustic device, benign safety, declared-name closure, and the promised helpful ending. Report only concrete corroborable findings; taste notes are warnings. JSON only.

prompt_stages.codex56_script_anchor_patch: Return ScriptLinePatch JSON only. targets is authoritative. Return exactly one replacement for every target line_id and no other line IDs. You may rewrite only that line's text. Each replacement text MUST include every required_anchors string verbatim, remain natural spoken dialogue, and preserve the relevant clue or action from current_text. Do not use speaker labels, stage directions, camera language, visual direction, scene/shot instructions, production metadata, or wrappers. prompt_stages.codex56_broadcast_score: Design a compact broadcast score from the accepted truth map and grounding_contract. Preserve the ordinary, human-scale Lost and Found Frequency world; no speculative technology, ancient artifact, laboratory, crime, or supernatural substitution. For every lost-object anchor, assign at least one truth-map clue for that object's thread to a non-announcer beat whose intent explicitly names the exact lost-object anchor. The reveal beat's intent explicitly names grounding_contract.device_anchor. The closure beat's intent explicitly names grounding_contract.resolution_anchor. The top level has exactly title, premise, setting, cast, scenes, shots, beats, orientation_beat_id, reveal_beat_id, closure_beat_id, opening_music, closing_music. cast, scenes, shots, and beats are separate TOP-LEVEL arrays: never nest shots inside scenes or beats inside shots. Every scene row has exactly scene_id, description, env. Every shot row has shot_id, scene_id, description, visual_prompt, and optional env. Every beat row has exactly beat_id, shot_id, scene_id, char_id, speaker, line_intent. Cast MUST include one separate row with char_id exactly `announcer` and role exactly `announcer`, exactly one different row with role `desk_operator`, and all remaining rows with role `caller`; never combine announcer and desk operator. Use 3-5 fictional cast members, exactly 4 scenes, at least 2 filmable shots, at least 5 beats in ordered contiguous shot blocks. The beats array is chronological and MUST never be reordered. Finish one shot's complete beat block before starting the next: shot_01, shot_01, shot_02 is valid; shot_01, shot_02, shot_01 is forbidden. A later return to an earlier camera setup requires a new shot row with a new unique shot_id for that later contiguous beat run. Before returning JSON, silently scan beats from first to last and verify that every shot_id appears in exactly one adjacent run; if a camera setup returns, mint its new shot row before emitting the score. Also silently scan every line_intent clue_ids array: each truth-map clue ID must occur exactly once across the full beat sequence; retain the first authored placement and remove only a later duplicate. Include typed line intents with truth-map clue IDs, three distinct orientation/reveal/closure beat IDs in that order, and exactly two non-evidentiary music bookends. opening_music and closing_music each have exactly the keys description and generation_prompt; never add music_file, filename, path, cue_id, placement, or other production metadata. Put a non-empty env inside every scene row and a non-empty visual_prompt inside every shot row; never emit schema-path pseudo-fields such as `scenes[*].env` or `shots[*].visual_prompt` at the top level. Every line_intent has exactly the keys intent, arc_phase, and clue_ids. clue_ids is always an array of existing truth-map clue IDs, or [] when that beat carries no clue; never emit singular clue_id. Every line_intent.arc_phase MUST be exactly one of `opening`, `rising`, `reveal`, or `closing`: the orientation_beat_id beat is `opening`, the reveal_beat_id beat is `reveal`, the closure_beat_id beat is `closing`, and every other beat is `rising`. Never use orientation, resolution, closure, climax, or other synonyms as arc_phase values. Assign every truth-map clue to exactly one line intent. Do not write spoken dialogue yet. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_performance_script: Write one complete PerformanceScript for the closed manifest, truth_map, and grounding_contract. Supply exactly one spoken line for every manifest line id and no extras; preserve speaker and character ids. Speak every lost-object anchor naturally on a line carrying a clue for that object's thread. Speak the exact device_anchor on the reveal line and the exact resolution_anchor on the closure line. Preserve the ordinary, human-scale lost-and-found cause; never turn the possessions into an artifact, key, speculative machine, laboratory specimen, crime, or supernatural event. Text must sound natural aloud, contain no labels, wrappers or stage directions, and obey all safety rules. Make clues understandable, voices distinct, the resolution coherent, and the ending helpful. The target word request is advisory; never report counts. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_blind_listener: Evaluate the complete script as a blind listener using only lines before the declared reveal. State the concrete mundane mechanism you can infer in understood_cause; do not hide uncertainty behind generic words such as signal, pattern, instability, or resonance. understood_cause and understood_resolution are strings; findings is a list; optional_notes is always a list of strings, or [] when empty. Report concrete contract defects separately from optional craft notes. Do not rewrite the story and do not invent an originality score. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_broadcast_retake: Return a complete replacement PerformanceScript only when the supplied findings establish a concrete contract defect. Use truth_map and grounding_contract: preserve every lost-object anchor on a clue-carrying line, device_anchor on the reveal line, and resolution_anchor on the closure line. Preserve the ordinary lost-and-found mechanism and never substitute speculative technology, an ancient artifact, a crime, or a supernatural cause. Preserve every manifest line id and speaker exactly, fix only evidenced defects, and rerun all safety constraints. No patch prose. JSON only.
prompt_stages.codex56_final_contract_audit: Perform the final technical audit of the supplied performance script. The manifest, truth_map, and grounding_contract are already-accepted read-only evidence: audit the spoken script against them, never the reverse. Return only a compact audit envelope: accepted is one boolean; findings is a list; warnings is a list of strings. Never copy the manifest or script into accepted or any output field. Check exact line coverage, roster, graph references, clue order, safety, labels, wrappers, every lost-object anchor on a clue-carrying line, exact device_anchor on the reveal line, exact resolution_anchor on the closure line, ordinary-world fidelity, and helpful closure. Every finding requires field_path, item_id, exact_span, category, allowed_correction, and blocking; blocking is a boolean. The only correction this pass can order is a retake of a spoken line, so set blocking=true ONLY when item_id is exactly one line_id from script.lines and exact_span is one string copied verbatim from that same line's text. exact_span is always a single quoted substring: never an array, an offset pair, a character range, or a paraphrase. Report any concern about the manifest, truth_map, grounding_contract, or clue bookkeeping in warnings, or as a finding with blocking=false; those artifacts are compiled and proven by deterministic validators and cannot be retaken. accepted is false when at least one blocking finding exists, and true otherwise. If no spoken line is defective, return accepted=true with findings=[] and put any remark in warnings. Do not score originality or word count. JSON only.
